title: API and MCP integrations
intro: Create a token for one selected page. Choose read access, document editing, and MCP access for its recipient.
scopeBoundary: Document access covers bounded text blocks. Child pages, database values, attachments, comments, and history are excluded. Read responses omit source archives, formatting, structured links, and user metadata. Same-ID edits preserve existing metadata. Body replacement returns 409 when unsupported or private import blocks would be lost.
liveBoundary: Every API request checks current membership, page access, expiry and revocation. Being a server administrator does not add access.
environment: Availability is managed in environment settings. This screen does not change server configuration.
loaded: The current token list has been reviewed.
name: Purpose name
nameHint: Use a recognizable name without secrets.
limitHint: Limits: {active} active tokens and {metadata} records in total, including expired and revoked tokens. Expiry uses server time.
reviewHint: Secrets or personal information written directly in the text are included in document scope. Review the recipient and purpose.
consent: I reviewed this page, expiry, and the read, write, and MCP permissions granted to anyone who receives this token.
created: Token created. Its secret cannot be shown again after this view is closed.
secretHint: The secret is not placed in URLs or device storage. Keep it safely before closing this view.
copyUnavailable: Automatic copy is unavailable. Show, select and copy the secret.
finishHint: This secret cannot be shown again. The token remains valid until expiry or revocation.
secretUnavailable: The token was created, but its secret cannot be shown again. Revoke it before creating a replacement.
unknown: The creation result is unknown. The request is retained and new creation is stopped. Review the list first.
pendingHint: Only request metadata is retained. The bearer secret is never stored.
retryHint: Only the same request is sent. If already created, no secret is returned and no second token is created.
empty: You have not created any tokens.
targetUnavailable: The target page is currently unavailable
revokeHint: This token will no longer read or edit content, or connect through MCP. Copies already obtained cannot be recalled.
signIn: Sign in to manage your tokens.
accountsDisabled: Accounts are disabled on this server.
accountChanged: The account changed or the session expired. Actions have been stopped.
denied: This action or target is currently unavailable.
conflict: Content changed first. Your input is retained. Review the list and target.
quota: The creation limit has been reached. Review existing tokens and expiry.
unavailable: The request could not be reviewed. Your input is retained. Please try again.
journalError: Request metadata cannot be read or saved, so new token creation is stopped.
restored: A previous creation request was restored. Review the list before continuing.
endpoints: Endpoint examples (put the secret in the Authorization header)
retained: Uncertain requests are retained in this tab’s account-scoped session storage. They contain no document body or bearer secret.
leave: A secret or uncertain creation request is open. Leave this screen?
rejected: This creation request was not accepted. Review your input, then review the new request before creating.
localeFallbackNotice: Some labels use English. Page names and content are not translated.
writeScope: Edit the title and supported document blocks
mcpScope: Connect to this page through MCP
writeHint: Editing requires permission to edit this page and includes document read access. Read-only pages cannot receive a write grant.
writeReviewHint: The recipient can change the page title and replace supported text blocks. Writes require the current version; conflicts return 409 and are not retried automatically.
mcpReviewHint: The recipient can use the MCP endpoint with this token. Its tools and resource stay within the page and permissions shown here.
mcpEnabled: MCP is enabled on this server.
mcpDisabled: MCP is disabled on this server. Existing API tokens remain listed.
mcpStatusUnavailable: MCP availability could not be verified. MCP grants are unavailable; other token permissions remain available.
accessChanged: The page's permissions changed. Review the current target and permissions before creating the token.
writeRequestHint: PATCH sends JSON with expectedVersion and title or blocks. Read the latest version first. A 409 conflict requires review; no automatic retry.
mcpRequestHint: MCP uses Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp with the same Bearer header. Clients must accept application/json and text/event-stream. No session ID is used.
